summary: Queried Cookbook BigQuery data for current menu items (non-dormant/non-draft/effective) across Royal Greens, Limesalt, Yasas, Hanu Poke; extracted customization options with max_choices set (16 true main items, 71 rows) and compared main-item vs preset customization settings (custom_type/max/min/free_choices), finding 12.7% (102/804) of option-preset pairs differ. Saved full report to A2-Data Research.
learned: 134 items with item_customization in these 4 brands' active menus include 108 that are themselves presets directly listed in the menu items[] array - must filter preset_item_version_info IS NULL to isolate true main/parent items.
Preset option ids are newly generated UUIDs, not shared with the parent option id - matching parent vs preset customization must be done by option name, not option_id.
menus table has no 'deleted' column; brand-menu identification uses status='ACTIVE' + concept_ids array length = 1 instead.
